text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Crosses the finish line!! First place is 
Air Messiah! Claiming the first tiara of 
the Oka Sho is Air Messiah!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Seizing the long-awaited cherry blossoms 
through pure dedication! Carrying the 
feelings entrusted by her mother, right 
now, Air Messiah blooms into a glorious 
victory!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOO!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Haah... haah... haah...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ah... huh—?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Congratulations, Messiah-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ! Craft-san—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...Aaaaagh, so frustrating!! Frustrating, 
frustrating, so frustrating!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
This is the one thing... This tiara is the 
one thing!! I refused to surrender it to 
anyone, anyone at all.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Still, that is why, at the very 
least...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'm glad that you were the one who won it.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Messiah-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Staring intently at the end of the light 
leading to the track, my mind races 
desperately. However... nothing comes to 
mind!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I think, I can't find 
the right words of congratulations to 
offer Air Messiah upon her return!
choice_data_list: (I mean... it's a victory in the Oka Sho!)
(I mean... it's a victory in the Oka Sho!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course, it wasn't that I doubted my 
trainee's ability. I truly believed that 
Air Messiah would definitely bring us 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“However, even so, the immense greatness 
of what was accomplished remains 
unchanged.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How should I put it? How on earth do I say 
it? What words could possibly praise it 
enough—
choice_data_list:
(I'll be able to give you my fullest 
blessings.)

(I'll be able to celebrate you with all my 
heart)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...While doing so, the appointed time 
arrived—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ah... Trainer-san—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"There was no longer any time to think. I 
simply let out a shout, surrendering to 
pure emotionâ"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No. To be exact, she bowed deeply first. 
...And with incredible force, at that.
choice_data_list: Truly a magnificent run, I am in awe!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list:
Th-Thank you so much for this 
opportunity!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
choice_data_list:
Please accept my sincerest congratulations 
on your Oka Sho victory!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The silence stings. ...The stares of the 
other Umamusume walking back through the 
underground passage, and their whispers as 
if they'd seen a freak, sting even more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, just as I was wondering if I 
should simply collapse right then and 
there—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Not at all, don't mention it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply delighted by your kind words 
of congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...This is a victory we seized together. 
Of that, I am utterly certain, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah told me so with her head held 
high. Because of that, nothing else 
mattered anymore. ...Or so I felt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our Oka Sho alongside Air Messiah 
concluded with the best possible result...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, even with the Oka Sho over, we 
cannot afford to let our guard down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I open "Race_Schedule_5" in the shared 
cloud folder and type into the main goal 
field. —"The Oaks".

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara has only just finished 
its first race...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
By late next month, the second leg, the 
Oaks, will already be upon us.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The longest of the Triple Tiara at 2,400 
meters... There is no doubt that this race 
will test our fundamental stamina even 
further.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: And as I mentioned before—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The final leg of the Triple Tiara, the 
Shuka Sho, is a race that holds 
significant meaning for me.
choice_data_list: We can't let our guard down just yet.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes... First, let us make adjustments for 
the Oaks. I'll be in your care.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, then.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Heading into the Oaks, stamina training 
is definitely the top priority... I need 
to structure my self-training around that 
too—)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ehh~~~, seriously!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
For real, for real! The press conference 
video is already out! You gotta check it 
out too!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
No way... wait, that's incredible! Line 
Craft-chan, are you for real...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (? ...Craft-san?)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(The press conference footage... Is this 
it?)

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"D-Does that mean...! You intend to change 
course at this stage!?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. I'm still thinking about the Shuka 
Sho... but at the very least, I won't be 
running in the Yushun Himba (Japanese 
Oaks).

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'm heading for the 'NHK Mile Cup'!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Because out there is a path that only I 
can run... A brilliance that only I can 
show!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I want to forge my own path! With these 
legs! With my running!"
